title: Privacy requests
description: Find what is stored about a driver by name, phone or plate, then export it or erase it.

form.name: Driver name
form.hint: Matches are exact: the whole name in any letter case, the phone in international format, the plate without spaces or dashes. Any one identifier is enough.

errors.identifier: Enter a name, phone or plate.
errors.name: Enter the whole name, 2 to 120 characters.
errors.phone: Use the international format, for example +49 151 2345678.

start.title: Search for a driver
start.description: The search covers the avis data of every booking and the safety acknowledgements of this company.

no_match.title: Nothing stored
no_match.description: No booking or acknowledgement matches these identifiers.

erase_dialog.title: Erase this driver's data?
erase_dialog.description: This cannot be undone. The bookings stay for the KPIs, without the driver.
erase_dialog.bookings: Bookings to pseudonymize (name, phone and plates removed): {{count}}
erase_dialog.restrict: Acknowledgements still under retention, to restrict: {{count}}
erase_dialog.confirm: I have verified the identity of the person who made this request.

erased: Done: {{bookings}} bookings pseudonymized, {{restricted}} acknowledgements restricted, {{pseudonymized}} pseudonymized.
